reauth_confirm.description: Re-pair with your B&D SmartDoorDevices hub. In the B&D Smart Garage Access app, go to Settings → Users → your hub → Add new user, then note the activation code and password it shows you.

data_description.host: The new LAN IP address of your B&D hub (Basestation). Check your router's DHCP client list.

reconfigure.description: Update the address Home Assistant uses to reach your hub. Your pairing is kept, so the doors and their history stay as they are.
